scripts.dev: npm run build -w @webtoon/contracts && concurrently -k -n contracts,api,web "npm run dev -w @webtoon/contracts" "npm run dev -w @webtoon/api" "npm run dev -w @webtoon/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @webtoon/contracts && npm run build -w @webtoon/api && npm run build -w @webtoon/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @webtoon/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @webtoon/contracts && npm run test -w @webtoon/api
scripts.test:integration: npm run build -w @webtoon/contracts && npm run test:integration -w @webtoon/api
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
